Libraries and fonts that build the advisor summary PDF in the browser, self-hosted so the site makes no request outside its own origin.

Every file is byte-identical to the one in the npm package named below, except LICENSE-fontkit. Each tarball was fetched with `npm pack <package> --ignore-scripts`
from the npm registry into an empty folder outside the repository and extracted as data (nothing from it was run); its sha512 matched the registry's dist.integrity.
Files were copied out of the extracted tarball into this folder, unmodified.
To update: pack the new version the same way, replace the files, rewrite this list (`sha256sum` of every file), and run `npm test` and `npm run test:browser`.

LICENSE-fontkit: the @pdf-lib/fontkit package declares MIT and ships no license file. This is the LICENSE file of foliojs/fontkit, the project it was forked from.

Why static fonts and not web/fonts: the site's variable Rubik embeds only its lightest weight here, since this fontkit fork cannot select a weight, so it has no bold. The static files have a real bold.
Why only these files: fontkit is the UMD build, since its ES build imports a bare module name a browser cannot resolve. It sets a global, so it is loaded with a script element. The Arabic, Cyrillic and
extended Latin fonts are in regular weight only and are fetched only when the text holds such a letter (a student's name).
These libraries only ever read this site's own fonts and strings, never a file from outside. pdf-lib and fontkit have had no release since 2021 and 2020.
